editorial.blurb: Li Hing delivers honest Chinese food at unbeatable prices, with fresh, flavorful dishes that keep customers coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order lunch specials (around $6-7) that bundle an entrée, egg roll, soup, and rice—exceptional value and portion sizes, especially the eggdrop soup.

topDishes.note: Extremely flavorful, not oversauced, delivers great taste for the price
Extremely fresh and delicious, fried option available
